method.rf: US 10-year Treasury yield (Yahoo ^TNX) at the calendar year-end
method.beta: 60 monthly returns vs the S&P 500 (^GSPC) ending at year-end (min 24), Blume-adjusted 0.67 x raw + 0.33
method.erp: Damodaran, Historical Implied Equity Risk Premiums (histimpl.xls, implied premium FCFE, start of the following year)
method.crp: Argentina: J.P. Morgan EMBI spread at year-end (api.argentinadatos.com riesgo-pais); China: Damodaran, Country Default Spreads and Risk Premiums (ctryprem21-24.xlsx archives and the Jan-2026 ctryprem.xlsx; rating-based CRP: China A1, Brazil Ba2/Ba1, Taiwan Aa3, Korea Aa2)
method.kd: Interest expense / average total debt (Yahoo statements) clamped to [rf, rf+10%]; else rf + model credit spread (+ EMBI for YPF); after tax at the effective rate (0-35%)
method.weights: Market cap (shares x close at year-end) vs book total debt at fiscal year-end, USD
method.currency: USD terms for all tickers (ASML/ABEV: USD ADR beta and US rf; EUR debt at the ECB, BRL debt at the BCB PTAX and TWD debt at the Yahoo TWD=X year-end rate; Samsung: KRX price converted to USD at Yahoo KRW=X daily, KRW debt at year-end KRW=X)
